summary: Off-registry HTTP dependency source in package.json controls installed code
details: package.json declares its sole dependency `marker-index-symbol-schema` as a bare HTTPS URL (https://artifacts.creditslib.com/npm/marker-index-symbol-schema) rather than a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches whatever bytes that URL returns at install time, with no version pin and no integrity check, and executes any lifecycle scripts contained in the fetched tarball. The shipped index.js re-exports that dependency, so `require()` of this package also loads the fetched code. The host artifacts.creditslib.com is unrelated to the @flexmr publisher scope and homepage, and whoever controls that host controls code that runs on the installer's machine. The manifest line is itself the install-time code-inclusion vector; the inert stub in the tarball does not mitigate it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
